title: Act: Return focus to the trigger when the sheet closes
summary: Add returnFocusRef prop and trigger ref in App
description: ContributionSheet accepts optional returnFocusRef; DialogContent onCloseAutoFocus focuses it; App holds the ref on the trigger button.
acceptance_criteria: Given a returnFocusRef with a current element, when the sheet closes, then that element receives focus
Given no returnFocusRef is passed, when the sheet closes, then the Radix default focus restoration applies

steps.action: Add optional field returnFocusRef?: RefObject<HTMLElement | null> to ContributionSheetProps (import type RefObject from react), destructure it, and add onCloseAutoFocus on DialogContent that calls event.preventDefault() then returnFocusRef?.current?.focus() only when the ref has a current element.
steps.expected: With a ref given, focus goes to it on close; without, Radix default applies

steps.action: Import useRef, add const triggerRef = useRef<HTMLButtonElement>(null) after the sheetOpen state, set ref={triggerRef} on the Suggest What Happens Next button, and pass returnFocusRef={triggerRef} to ContributionSheet.
steps.expected: Trigger receives focus after the sheet closes
